newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek markets pick socialists to win - GNN poll.
newsitem.headline: Greek markets pick socialists to win - GNN poll.

text.p: Greek markets picked the socialist PASOK party and Prime Minister Costas Simitis to win general elections on September 22 in an informal poll conducted by Reuters on Thursday.
A total of 32 bank dealers, mutual fund managers and brokers participated in the poll. Participants were asked to express the dealing room consensus of their bank, mutual fund and brokerage.
1) Which party do you think is going to win the elections?
Conservative New Democracy party 2 votes or 6.25%
Do not know/do not answer 9 votes or 28.13%
2) Which party would you like to see win the elections?
Conservative New Democracy party 5 votes or 15.63%
Do not know/no answer/smaller parties 10 votes or 31.25%
